verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation in the pack describes registrable outbound HTTP webhooks that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to for Netlify events. The only mention is a single community comment listing "forms/webhooks" without detail. It is ambiguous and could refer to inbound build hooks, so it does not establish documented event subscriptions. The REST API, CLI, and SDK citations are developer building blocks, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
